title: Portable Conductivity Meter Repeatability Study
summary: Completed controlled comparison of three portable conductivity meters using a certified reference solution and repeated stabilized readings.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE CONTROL
sections.body:
**Project Code:** EA-CON-2608

**Study Title:** Portable Conductivity Meter Repeatability Study

**Sponsoring Division:** Environmental Analysis

**Principal Investigator:** Technical Lead (role)

**Authorized Personnel Roster Ref.:** EA-TL2 duty roster

**Laboratory / Bay:** General wet-analysis workspace

**Start Date / Time:** 2026-08-19 / 09:00

**Shift Supervisor:** Laboratory Supervisor (role)

sections.title: EXPERIMENTAL BASIS
sections.body:
**Hypothesis:** Each meter will report the certified solution within ±2 percent, with within-instrument relative standard deviation not exceeding 1 percent.

**Control Condition:** Certified 1,413 µS/cm conductivity solution at 25 °C, with deionized-water blank.

**Test Condition(s):** Three meters; five sequential readings per meter after temperature compensation and stabilization.

**Acceptance / Failure Criteria:** Mean result within ±2 percent of the certified value and relative standard deviation at or below 1 percent.

**Known Hazards:** Low-hazard aqueous standard, wet-bench slip potential, and powered instrumentation near liquids.

**Containment / Isolation Required:** Secondary tray and ordinary wet-bench controls; no special isolation required.

sections.title: SPECIMEN ACCOUNTABILITY
sections.body:
**Specimen / Article ID:** STD-COND-1413-L2608; DI-BLANK-2608.

**Source / Custodian:** Metrology supply inventory / duty custodian.

**Quantity Received:** 500 mL reference solution; 1 L deionized-water blank.

**Seal / Container Condition:** Manufacturer seal intact at issue; working aliquots prepared in clean secondary containers.

**Chain-of-Custody Ref.:** EA-COC-2608-07.

**Return / Destruction Requirement:** Unused sealed stock returned to inventory; working aliquots disposed through the ordinary laboratory waste stream.

sections.title: INSTRUMENTATION & INCIDENT CONTROL
sections.body:
**Instrumentation / Serial Nos.:** CM-021; CM-024; CM-031; reference thermometer REF-006.

**Calibration Verified:** Yes

**Environmental Conditions:** 22.1 ±0.4 °C; no direct solar load; bench surfaces dry at start.

**Recording Systems:** Manual

**Escalation Recommended:** No

**Chronological Observation Log:** 09:00 setup and label check complete. 09:18 blank checks complete. 09:31 reference series opened. 10:22 final replicate complete. 10:40 calculations independently reviewed. Maximum mean error was 1.1 percent; maximum relative standard deviation was 0.6 percent.
